features: 50-DAY LONG BATTERY LIFE - FYFIT Fitness Band Pro is designed with a long-lasting battery that can provide up to 50 days of battery life under suitable usage conditions, reducing the need for frequent charging and making it ideal for everyday fitness tracking.

HEART RATE & SPO2 TRACKING - Monitor heart rate and blood oxygen (SpO2) levels using the built-in sensors. The fitness band provides convenient wellness data to help you understand your daily activity and exercise patterns.

HRV & SLEEP TRACKING - Track HRV-related data and monitor your sleep patterns to better understand your daily rest and recovery trends. A useful companion for maintaining awareness of your everyday wellness and lifestyle habits.

DAILY ACTIVITY & FITNESS TRACKER - Track your everyday movement and activity with a convenient wearable fitness band. Suitable for walking, running, workouts, gym sessions, outdoor activities and daily fitness routines.

SMART FITNESS BAND FOR EVERYDAY USE - Combining multiple health and activity tracking features in a compact wearable design, FYFIT Fitness Band Pro is suitable for men and women looking for a practical fitness tracker for everyday activity, exercise and wellness monitoring.
1 YEAR WARRANTY - Enjoy complete peace of mind with a 1-year brand warranty, ensuring reliable performance and hassle-free support.
